post.summary: Create or update an AI dashboard
post.description: Creates a dashboard (id derived from the name) or, when dashboard_id matches an existing one, replaces it. Returns { success, id, dashboard }. The field names differ from the stored ones: dashboard_name (not name), widget_id (not id) and layout { pos_x, pos_y, grid_w, grid_h }. Widget types: timeseries, table, bar_chart, pie_chart, stat, heatmap, bubble_chart, sankey, chord. Administrators only.

parameters.description: JSON body, e.g. { "dashboard_name": "Network overview", "description": "", "widgets": [{ "widget_id": "w1", "type": "stat", "title": "Flows", "config": { "sql_query": "SELECT count() AS value FROM flows WHERE FIRST_SEEN >= $EPOCH_BEGIN$ AND FIRST_SEEN <= $EPOCH_END$ AND INTERFACE_ID = $IFID$ AND $FILTERS$", "value_field": "value", "unit": "number" }, "layout": { "pos_x": 0, "pos_y": 0, "grid_w": 4, "grid_h": 3 } }] }. get.description: The flows currently active on the interface, with paging, sorting and the same filters of the Live Flows page. Each flow carries client and server (ip, name, port, vlan, asn, country...), application, l4_proto, bytes, throughput, score, alerts, first_seen/last_seen and, on flow-based interfaces, the exporter (the router/switch that exported the flow) and its input/output interfaces; on view interfaces seen_on_interface { id, name } is the interface of the view where ntopng saw the flow. recordsTotal is the number of flows matching the filters.
